except_prefix.description: Values starting with this prefix are never replaced: director-issued bcw- ids stay stable (RING0 §4).

target.description: For jsonpath: an RFC 9535 path using only the root $, child .name, descendant ..name and wildcard [*] segments, so a stdlib applier can match it. For run_value: the name of a run value (sandbox_root or director_port) that the masking caller supplies; every occurrence of that value is replaced by the placeholder, except inside a director-issued id (bcw- and 16 lowercase hex digits, keyed.mint_id), which stays stable (RING0 §4). For pattern: a regular expression with no capturing groups, matched against body text; every match is replaced by the placeholder. It masks random ids that a host or system mints into body text, such as a Hermes session id in a compaction summary or a recall result, or a memory store's record id (RING0 §4).
